name: video_speak_models_list
description: Lip-sync model catalog for `video_speak`, which is only for keeping an exact voice or one voice across clips; other talking video goes through `video_generate` with a native-audio model. Lean, filtered to what the caller can actually run. Each entry declares whether it takes an `image` or a `video` source, its audio duration limits and its resolutions. Read before calling `video_speak`.
